scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@wwbox/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@wwbox/desktop
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release:helper: dotnet publish native/WutheringWavesBox.Helper/WutheringWavesBox.Helper.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true --output apps/desktop/release-helper
scripts.release:win: npm run release:helper && npm run build --workspace=@wwbox/contracts && npm run release:win --workspace=@wwbox/desktop
scripts.release:portable: npm run release:helper && npm run build --workspace=@wwbox/contracts && npm run release:portable --workspace=@wwbox/desktop
